# telnyx_sim_card_bulk_enable_voice (Action)

Enables voice on every SIM card of a SIM card group.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sim_card_group_id` (String)

### Optional

- `connection_id` (String) The identifier of the Mobile Voice Connection to associate with the SIM cards. The connection must be owned by the same user and of type <code>mobile_voice</code>. If omitted, voice is enabled without a connection association.
